body:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv_cache metadata growth spike detected on paged-blockmanager (cluster: us-west-2-primary). Metric: kv.meta.bytes_per_block +300% over 5m. Possible metadata leak / batch-regression. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/kv-cache/kv-metrics

sam (oncall): I'm looking. seeing concurrent OOMs on a few hosts. attaching sample logs.

maya: looks like continuous batching rate jumped for /v1/embeddings, prefix cache pressure spiked. could be a change from the last rollout.

jordan: grabbing the last deploy. `deploy-bot` shows canary completed ~45m ago: `deploy/2024-10-28/kvm-optim`

sophie: customer-facing: @irene-csm any reports from customers?

irene-csm: yes — two enterprise tenants reported increased 5xxs starting ~20:14 UTC. they're seeing model timeouts and retries. flagged as P2.

sam (oncall): immediate mitigation: stop continuous batching for latency sensitive routes, drop large-prefix prefetching, and enable aggressive eviction. I'll run the config change in staging then prod.

maya: recommended quick change: reduce kv.block_size from 8MB -> 2MB and set eviction.watermark to 0.6. that should reduce metadata per-block growth.

jordan: running quick dry-run on canary host:
```bash
ssh infra-canary-12
sudo systemctl stop redwood-kv-cache
sudo /usr/local/bin/kvtool --set block_size=2097152 --set eviction_watermark=0.6
sudo systemctl start redwood-kv-cache
```

deploy-bot: Rolling config patch to canary: PATCH /api/internal/configs/kv-cache -> id=kvm-quickfix-1716543210 (canary: infra-canary-12)

sam (oncall): canary shows immediate drop in metadata allocation and no OOMs after restart. latency for /v1/embeddings increased slightly but within SLOs for canary. proceeding to prod in 2 waves.

maya: also disabling continuous batching for route `/v1/embeddings` via route flag to avoid regen of large KVs until we understand root cause. command: 
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/embeddings",
  "continuous_batching": false
}
```

jordan: executing prod wave1 (10% hosts): `kubectl rollout restart ds/kv-cache -l kv-group=primary --field-selector spec.nodeName=...`

deploy-bot: Prod wave1 applied to 12 hosts. Monitoring...

sam (oncall): metric update: kv.meta.bytes_per_block down 72% on wave1 hosts, overall cluster drop ~40%. 5xx rate for affected tenants trending down.

irene-csm: relaying to customers: Tenant A reports partial recovery, Tenant B still sees occasional 502s. They're asking for ETA.

sophie: ETA: finishing wave2 in ~15m, then validate for 30m. I'll take communications and ask CSM to update tenants. assigning follow-ups: postmortem owner = sophie.

liam: picking up handoff in 1h — will keep watch on long-tail. items to follow: confirm root cause of metadata growth, evaluate continuous batching regression test, add unit to guard batch size growth.

sam (oncall): final notes before handoff:
- mitigation: reduced block_size 8MB->2MB, eviction.watermark 0.85->0.6, disabled continuous_batching on /v1/embeddings
- deployment: canary -> prod wave1 (12 hosts) -> prod wave2 (full) completed by 1716543910
- customer impact: 2 enterprise tenants saw 5xxs and timeouts, partial recovery for Tenant A, Tenant B intermittent 502s until wave2 completion
- logs/artifacts: https://logs.internal/redirect/kv/1716543210 (sample OOMs + stack traces)

jordan: leaving these snippets from host before/after patch:
```text
Before:  OOM at mempool_alloc: kv_meta_reserved=1.2GB blocks=150
After:   kv_meta_reserved=320MB blocks=120
```

sophie: creating postmortem ticket and tagging research/eng-runtime and qa for regression tests. ticket: https://phab.internal/T1234

deploy-bot: Noted: rollback not needed; hotfix config remains active.

liam: oncall handoff note: I'll monitor for 6h and work with maya on creating a test that simulates high-concurrency prefix regeneration. @maya please pair with me tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam (oncall): thanks team. marking incident as mitigated. will update incident channel and join debrief in 1h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to SEV-2.

sophie: assigning postmortem folks: owners = [sophie, maya, jordan], timeline owner = sophie. will collect logs and root-cause analysis.

irene-csm: customers updated, one asked for a summary and preventive steps. I'll coordinate with sophie.

sam (oncall): handoff to liam at 1716544210. leaving runbook excerpt: `if metadata growth spike > 200% then set block_size=2MB and enable eager-eviction`, plus link to runbook: https://wiki.internal/kv-cache/runbook-metadata-leak

liam: acknowledged, taking watch.
